acceptance_gates.solver: Existing regularization.equilibrium._scipy TRF/LSMR with analytic tangent callback and condition-number-report adapter; no new nonlinear iteration
acceptance_gates.B0: Legacy two-face displacement grips; classical P*N on remaining faces; grip reactions retained
acceptance_gates.B1: Fixed surrogate-derived nodal forces on topology-influenced support; same grip geometry; no adaptive load update
acceptance_gates.B2: LOCALITY-STRONG REFERENCE: constrain physical nodes with d_boundary<delta on all six faces; zero external load; in-domain support adaptation, not a proved equivalent exterior formulation
acceptance_gates.B3: DEFERRED: no uniquely validated BAQP ghost K/F/Z and physical-only energy/flux mapping
acceptance_gates.support: Direct truncated/partial-volume family seeds expanded by two actual bond-graph hops; not a physical 3delta collar
acceptance_gates.refinement_policy: After normal and shear B1 gates, two small coefficient/virtual-work/support comparisons at fixed L; no additional equilibrium campaign

normalization.force: ||P||F * L^2, because closed-surface net target is zero
normalization.moment: ||P||F * L^3; reference X-cross-force per request; current-x moment separate
normalization.virtual_work: Nonzero target: absolute relative error; zero target: ||P||F*L^3*||A||F or force_scale*||c||
normalization.F: ||Fbar-Fexact||F / ||Fexact-I||F; geometric core d>=delta is NOT fully closed bulk

solver_diagnostic_note: Legacy surface_traction_mean/max fields are unpopulated placeholders for the nodal-force adapter. Use face_targets and saved external nodal loads; zeros in those legacy fields do not imply zero classical shear.
